summary: Wake queued block imports after downloader synchronization completes
details: Notify the block fetcher after successful legacy synchronization and after disabling snap sync, so an already queued tip can be imported without another block announcement or peer reconnection.
Coalesce completion notifications without blocking the downloader and retain normal header verification and block execution for queued blocks.
Add deterministic ETH/66 and ETH/67 regressions for full and snap synchronization, invalid block rejection and shutdown behavior, with required execution coverage in Fast CI.
